Sir William Heathcote’s steward

Born in Scotland, he had a wife Maria Augusta 46 and niece Isabella Davidson 22 in 1851 census.

He had retired by 1861 and was living in Shirley Common Road, Millbrook parish. [Awdry, Heathcote;  White Directory of Hampshire 1859; 1851 census]
